summary: Iter 110 — V2 CLIENT bridge partially verified. Backend endpoints /workouts/week, /workouts/{v2p:…}, /calendar/timeline all correctly splice Pietro's active plan_live_v2 (edc0be3a-…) placements: Run Easy 35min/treadmill + Mobility 20min on 2026-07-28, Run Long 60min/outdoor/key_session on 2026-07-31, source='engine_v2', approved=True, coach_locked=True, blocks[] populated (warmup + main + cooldown), rationale='Run Long — foundation phase', long_steady block carries pace_target='MP+90s' and fuel_cue, warmup dict present as compat field. Negative v2p:non-existent:bogus returns 404. V1 regression: synth_workouts_for_user() returns [] when profile.v2_flags.engine_v2 is falsy (unit-tested directly against DB). 9/10 pytest cases pass (1 skipped: /api/v2/coach/clients 404 for the HTTP-flavour V1 check — the DB-level check covers regression). FRONTEND FINDINGS: Login → Home works, but the client HOME schedule (ClientCalendarPanel) still shows every day as REST because it consumes /api/calendar/range which is NOT bridged (verified via curl: 2026-07-25→2026-08-02 returns all rest, workout=None). Only /calendar/timeline (Calendar tab) and /workouts/week are bridged. Additionally, the workout detail screen for the V2 Run Long only renders title/location/duration/rationale — it does NOT render the blocks[] array (warmup Z1 / long_steady MP+90s+fuel_cue / cooldown Z1) because /app/frontend/app/workout/[id]/index.tsx has no rendering path for blocks[] (only view.warmup as list-of-{name,duration_sec} and view.exercises for strength). The bridge emits warmup as a dict, so `view.warmup?.length > 0` check fails silently and the whole block-detail area is blank.

critical.issue: CLIENT HOME calendar (ClientCalendarPanel) consumes /calendar/range, which does NOT invoke feature_v2_client_bridge.synth_workouts_for_user. For Pietro (V2 client with active plan_live_v2), curl `/api/calendar/range?from=2026-07-25&to=2026-08-02` returns all days badge='rest' with workout=None. This is the very 'client dashboard shows nothing' bug the iteration was meant to solve. Fix: mirror the splice logic used in /workouts/week and /calendar/timeline inside feature_calendar_recovery.calendar_range (lines 418-422) — merge V2 synthetic rows into by_date when the legacy record is absent.

minor.issue: When a V2 day has 2 placements (Run Easy + Mobility on 2026-07-28), only ONE surfaces in day.workout_id/workout_title because wk_map is keyed by date. Timeline currently returns Run Easy for 2026-07-28 (Mobility is dropped). The synth list is in [Run Easy, Mobility] order so the first wins. If the intention is to only show the 'primary' workout per day that's fine, but the review spec asked to verify 3 rows on the day — timeline only shows 2 total workout entries for July.

ui_bugs.issue: V2 running workout detail page does not render blocks[]. Only view.warmup (expected as list-of-{name,duration_sec}) and view.exercises are rendered. For V2 running sessions from the bridge, warmup is a DICT ({duration_min, hr_zone, cue}), so `view.warmup?.length > 0` is falsy and the whole warmup/main/cooldown detail area is blank. Users see only title, focus, duration, KEY SESSION chip and rationale — no pace_target MP+90s, no fuel_cue, no long_steady Z2 block. Fix: add a blocks[] renderer (map each block → duration_min + hr_zone + pace_target + cue + fuel_cue) OR reshape the bridge output so warmup/main/cooldown become individual `exercises`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/workout/[id]/index.tsx:381-393 (warmup renderer expects array) and /app/backend/feature_v2_client_bridge.py:139 (warmup returned as dict).

Detail page loads (title/rationale/KEY SESSION render) but the actual session content (blocks with pace/HR/cue/fuel_cue) is not visible — pietro would open the card and see an empty body under 'Why this session?'.

action_items: PRIMARY FIX — Extend the V2 client bridge to /api/calendar/range. In /app/backend/feature_calendar_recovery.py:calendar_range (~line 418), after building `by_date`, call `synth_workouts_for_user(db, user['id'], start_iso=_iso(d_from), end_iso=_iso(d_to))` and merge into by_date where by_date[ds] is missing. Without this, Pietro's home schedule stays empty.

Render blocks[] on the running workout detail screen. Either (a) add a `view.blocks?.map(...)` renderer in /app/frontend/app/workout/[id]/index.tsx (below the rationale) that shows each block's type + duration_min + hr_zone + pace_target + cue + fuel_cue, OR (b) change feature_v2_client_bridge.synth_workout_from_placement to also expose warmup/main/cooldown as `exercises` entries so the existing exercise renderer picks them up. (a) is cleaner — the existing legacy strength renderer stays untouched.

Bridge output today sets `warmup: spec.payload.warmup` (a dict). The frontend's warmup block guard is `view.warmup?.length > 0` which is falsy for dicts. Coordinate the fix in step above so warmup is either a list-of-{name,duration_sec} (legacy shape) or is replaced entirely by blocks[] rendering.

OPTIONAL — On /calendar/timeline, if a day has multiple V2 placements (Run Easy + Mobility on 2026-07-28), decide whether to expose all in day cells (e.g. `workout_ids: [...], workout_titles: [...]`) or intentionally pick the key/highest-priority one. Currently the first synth row wins (Run Easy is shown, Mobility is silently dropped).
OPTIONAL — Fix the `Unexpected text node` warnings on workout/[id]/index.tsx (likely a stray whitespace between JSX children inside a <View>).
critical_code_review_comments: feature_v2_client_bridge.py is clean and focused (~230 lines) — good separation from server.py. It correctly guards on user.profile.v2_flags.engine_v2 or .v2_default so V1 clients stay unaffected.

The bridge is applied in 3 places (server.py: workouts_week, workout_get, calendar_timeline) but MISSING from feature_calendar_recovery.calendar_range — this is the actual endpoint the client home schedule consumes. If the review request had explicitly mentioned /calendar/range, this would have been caught earlier; the current design has 4 client-facing calendar/workout entrypoints and only 3 are bridged.

The synthetic workout row shape has warmup=dict (from spec.payload.warmup) but exercises=[] for running sessions. Downstream renderers expect either exercises populated (strength) or warmup as an array (legacy running structure). Consider a normalised 'render_blocks' field to decouple shape from routing choices.

rca_of_issue: PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE — The 'CLIENT dashboard still shows nothing after publish' bug is NOT fully resolved because feature_v2_client_bridge is applied to /workouts/week, /workouts/{id}, and /calendar/timeline only. The client home schedule (ClientCalendarPanel at /app/frontend/src/components/ClientCalendarPanel.tsx:254) consumes /calendar/range, which is defined in /app/backend/feature_calendar_recovery.py:calendar_range and still queries only the legacy `workouts` collection via _workouts_between(). Verified end-to-end: curl `/api/calendar/range?from=2026-07-25&to=2026-08-02` with Pietro's token returns badge='rest' + workout=None for every day, and the UI shows REST × 9 days. Fix: add the same synth_workouts_for_user() call inside calendar_range and merge into by_date. SECONDARY — Even after that fix, tapping the workout will open the detail page but only show title/rationale because /app/frontend/app/workout/[id]/index.tsx has no blocks[] renderer AND treats warmup as an array — the bridge emits warmup as a dict. Add a blocks[] renderer OR extend the bridge to convert running blocks into legacy exercises entries.
